title: Mark Sweney and Robert Booth's 'Nvidia Boss Says There Is 0% Chance AI Destroys the World by 2030'. He's Right, and the Laws He Wants Applied Just Failed Their First Test.
short_version: Jensen Huang says forget the doom and apply the laws we already have. Good. This year those laws met an AI agent inside a package registry and a model left on the open internet for seven months, and nothing happened.
